Subject: Pilot intro & hands-on workshop — Redwood x Finlytics

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We'd like to move to a short pilot (POC) to validate routing + prompt templates and run a lightweight load trial during the session. Can we schedule a 90‑minute hands‑on workshop the week of May 17?

Key folks from our side who should join: Tom Wallace (platform lead), Aisha Lim (data product owner), and two engineers from the integrator team (I can loop them in after we lock a time). Our goals:
- Validate prompt templates on our sample data
- Confirm routing behavior for multi‑tenant inputs
- Run a controlled load test to measure latency at 100 qps

Preferred windows: May 17 or May 18, mornings PT. We're flexible on exact time.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Head of Platform — Finlytics
Tom.W@finlytics.com

Hi Tom — great to hear. Sean (solutions engineer) and I will run the session.

I can do May 17 at 10:00 AM PT or May 18 at 9:00 AM PT. Proposed agenda (90 min):
1) 10 min intros & success criteria (stakeholders)
2) 25 min prompt review and tuning walkthrough
3) 30 min routing configuration and live traffic routing demo
4) 20 min controlled load run + metrics review
5) 5 min next steps and roll plan

Can you confirm which day/time works and who will be the primary technical contact so we can share access and a short runbook? I've attached an agenda draft and a starter prompt set.

Also: could you confirm the success criteria — e.g., 95th perc latency < 500ms, and accuracy thresholds for the prompt set?

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite once we lock it.

Monica — thanks. May 17 at 10:00 AM PT works for us. Confirmed participants:
- Tom Wallace (platform lead) — tom.w@finlytics.com
- Aisha Lim (data product owner) — aisha@finlytics.com
- Rajiv Patel (backend eng) — rajiv.p@finlytics.com
- Elena Cruz (integrations) — elena.c@finlytics.com

Success criteria from our side:
- Route correctness for 3 defined tenant classes (sample dataset attached)
- 95th percentile latency under 600ms during baseline (no load) and under 900ms during the controlled load at 100 qps
- No errors >0.5% during the test window

We put together a short load window plan — happy to share and refine. Attaching initial CSV with sample traffic and an outline of the load scenario. If you want the engineers in the session to run anything in advance, let us know.

Tom

Monica / Rishi — quick internal note before I reply with final logistics to Finlytics.

We should confirm the following operational items:
- Dedicated routing config: reserve a routing profile for the session (will isolate the tenant classes)
- KV cache: pre-warm with the sample prompts to avoid cold-start variance
- Load harness: I'll trigger a controlled load from our staging cluster pointed at the dedicated profile. Rishi, can you prepare the quantization profile we'll use so token timings are predictable?
- Monitoring: we'll enable a short retention trace (60m) for the session and pin the console dashboard to the invite
